pages.text: $(bold)Yuchuzi$(): Sukuna's blade — Cleave, Dismantle, Furnace: Open, all in one. $(br2)Folds $(bold)Cleave / Dismantle / Furnace: Open$() into a single technique (occupying only 1 technique slot). $(br2)$(bold)Controls$(): press $(bold)C$() to release the current move; press $(bold)F$() (the reversal key) to cycle the current move among Cleave → Dismantle → Furnace: Open.

$(bold)Cleave$(): a single slash at the target in your line of sight — damage = shared base × 70% (ignores invulnerability frames; can be reduced by armor), with sweeping particles. $(br2)$(bold)Dismantle$(): against targets in contact within 3 blocks, unleash 3 horizontal + 3 vertical = 6 slashes, each dealing half of Cleave. $(br2)$(bold)Furnace: Open$(): hold C to charge a flaming arrow in your main hand; release to fire it toward your current facing (straight and slow); on impact it triggers a flame explosion (which does not destroy blocks): center damage = (1+Affinity/100) × (current attack damage + Output×10) × 200%, falling off with distance, and it ignites an area with radius (1+Output).

$(bold)Cursed Energy costs$(): Cleave = base ×1; Dismantle = base ×2; Furnace: Open = base ×10 (base = (1-Affinity/100)×(10+Output×5)). $(br2)$(bold)Tip$(): switching moves (F) first auto-cancels a Furnace: Open charge; if you log out / die / are interrupted by the Inverted Spear of Heaven mid-charge, your original main-hand item is restored automatically.
